target_customer: Indian patients paying out of pocket for outpatient and elective care, and the private clinics that offer them monthly instalments
problem: Over 80 percent of Indian healthcare spending is out of pocket and few have private insurance, so elective care is hard to afford up front.
business_model: Healthcare BNPL and no cost EMI financing, earning fees from providers and lending partners, plus a provider discovery marketplace
product_category: Fintech: healthcare consumer lending and marketplace

founders.name: Jitin Bhasin
education: MBA, Indian Institute of Foreign Trade
founders.background_notes: YC page: second time fintech founder with 14 plus years across banking, fintech, insurance and consulting.

founders.name: Gaurav Luthra
founders.background_notes: YC page: serial entrepreneur with about a decade in consumer businesses in lifestyle, food and beverage and real estate.

founders.name: Anurag Varma
founders.background_notes: Named as a co-founder in the Inc42 funding article of April 2022; not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: ZestMoney
competitors.what: Indian BNPL and no cost EMI lender across retail

competitors.name: Healthfin
competitors.what: Pune medical loan and EMI product for treatment costs, incubated in NASSCOM 10,000 Startups

technical_complexity.rationale: Lending integrations, credit decisioning with NBFC partners and a 60 second checkout are standard fintech engineering, with the hard part being underwriting and partner onboarding rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: A provider network of 500 clinics in April 2022 and over 5,000 by the YC profile, plus lender relationships, is slow to copy, but general BNPL players could add healthcare.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General BNPL players and medical lenders such as Healthfin were already in the space. Later sources show lenders such as Fibe partnering with hospital chains, but SaveIN was still active and raising in 2025 with over 7,000 provider partners.

market_need_then: The YC page states that over 80 percent of Indian healthcare spend is out of pocket, fewer than 10 percent of Indians have private health insurance and medical inflation runs at about 15 percent a year. The April 2022 coverage reported 500 plus clinics onboarded across five cities.

branding.domain_note: Operates on savein.money, a non .com domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain consumer finance language built on the line Care Now, Pay Later.

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Inc42, Entrackr, YourStory and Entrepreneur India for funding and product news; no evidence of community or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Steady Indian business press coverage, but no source about brand perception. Expansion into travel and furniture in 2026 may stretch a name tied to savings and health.

outcome_analysis: SaveIN raised a $4 million seed in April 2022 right after Winter 2022, a further Pioneer Fund led seed in December 2022, and Rs 37 crore in April 2025, and reports over 5,000 to 7,000 partner clinics. The Indian healthcare affordability problem and a provider network drive its position, while BNPL rivals and lenders remain close. It is still active, though sources do not give revenue or profitability beyond a company target of break even in FY26.
notes: Conflicts: Inc42 says founded 2020 by Varma, Luthra and Bhasin; YC and Entrackr say 2022. The December 2022 Entrepreneur article says SaveIN raised $8 million over nine months, so the April and December rounds may overlap in that total, and it gives no amount for the December round. The 2025 article says the raise followed a Rs 64 crore seed and brings the total above Rs 100 crore; it does not name a stage, so the round is recorded as other. Aggregators label it Series A without a source. The 4.3 million dollar figure is from an Inc42 headline for the same Rs 37 crore round. The company website savein.money could not be fetched because the host did not resolve in this session's network. Competitor list is as of the April 2022 Inc42 article except Healthfin (2018). Uno Finance, founded 2018 per YourStory, is also a possible rival but was not dated near the batch. Inc42 dated 2022-07-14 (opened) reports roughly 3M USD more from existing investors including Bayhouse Capital and 10X Group, as an extension of the same seed after the April 4M USD, taking seed above 7M USD. The December 2022 Entrepreneur article gives a total of 8M USD over nine months and no amount for its own round, so it likely overlaps the April and July tranches (7M) plus a later top up of about 1M, and may not be a separate raise; its amount stays null.
